For max area histogram basic I will push indices and pop when a smaller bar appears.

```python
def largest(h):
    stack, out = [], 0
    for i, x in enumerate(h + [0]):
        while stack and h[stack[-1]] > x:
            j = stack.pop()
            left = stack[-1] if stack else -1
            out = max(out, h[j] * (i - left - 1))
        stack.append(i)
    return out
```
